title: dortmanna heterophylla
intro: Dortmanna heterophylla, commonly known as Marsh Cinquefoil, is a type of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including reducing inflammation, improving digestive issues, and supporting immune system function. The plant is believed to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its potential health benefits. Bioactive constituents present in Marsh Cinquefoil include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
